hint.text: Papier-mâché is a type of art made using paper, glue and water. A paste is made which can then be used to shape strips of paper into new shapes that harden after drying and can then be painted on.
hint.sound: ssml: Paper maché is a type of art made using paper, glue, and water. A paste is made which can then be used to shape strips of paper into new shapes that harden after drying, and can then be painted on.

atoms.text: Lee, Amina and César are working on an art project. Mr Hughes, their art teacher, explains that they will be making papier-mâché animals in groups. The group needs to decide which animal to make for their project.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='400ms'/>Lee, Amina, and Seh-zar are working on an art project. Mr Hughes, their art teacher, explains that they will be making paper maché animals in groups. The group needs to decide which animal to make for their project.

atoms.b: I want to make a lion. That’s my favourite animal!
I just want to make a normal cat. A lion would be too hard!
But what about a snake? That would be really easy. Snakes don’t have legs or tails.
Don’t forget, you can only make one animal. Choose wisely!
Hmmm, maybe I want to make a snake, too. That does sound easier than a lion!
Alright, then we have our animal!

instruction.text: Use the dialogue above to answer the questions.

atoms.a: Which student wanted to make a lion?
Whose idea was it to make the snake?
Who tells the group to choose only one animal?
Who thought making a lion would be too hard?
